ZA.summary: National, provincial and local spheres are distinct, interdependent and interrelated. District, local and metropolitan municipalities have different responsibilities.

schemes.name: Government spheres
schemes.note: Spheres are not a chain of command.

schemes.name: Local government
schemes.note: Metros operate separately from the district/local arrangement. Ward editions and statistical dates remain separate.

BW.summary: Local councils, parliamentary constituencies, council wards and traditional administration are separate schemes. The historical district map is not a map of today's local councils.

schemes.name: Local government
schemes.note: The ministry reports 31 local authorities. Council areas are not interchangeable with the 28 census districts used in 2022.

schemes.name: Electoral geography
schemes.note: The December 2024 parliamentary record reports 61 constituencies and 609 polling districts. Current electoral geometry has not been bundled.

schemes.name: Traditional administration
schemes.note: Traditional administration is a separate scheme; it is not an extra level below a local council.

institutions.name: National Assembly
institutions.description: Botswana's lawmaking assembly. Ntlo ya Dikgosi advises the Assembly on specified customary, constitutional and land matters.

institutions.name: Ntlo ya Dikgosi
institutions.description: Advises the National Assembly on matters within its constitutional remit. It is not presented as an equal lawmaking chamber.

institutions.name: Ministry of Local Government and Traditional Affairs
institutions.description: Supports local government and traditional administration. Its local-authority and traditional-administration schemes are recorded separately.

institutions.name: Statistics Botswana
institutions.description: Publishes official statistics, including the 2022 census. Census districts are a statistical geography with their own reference date.

institutions.name: Independent Electoral Commission
institutions.description: Botswana's electoral commission. Constituencies and council wards use an electoral scheme separate from the historical reference districts.

NA.summary: Regions and constituencies form the regional electoral scheme. Municipality, town and village authorities are a parallel local-government scheme; they are not a complete subdivision beneath constituencies.

schemes.name: Regional government and elections
schemes.note: The ministry's 19 March 2026 speech records 14 regions and 121 constituencies. Constituency geometry has not been bundled.

schemes.name: Local authorities
schemes.note: The same dated ministry source records 59 local authorities. These are parallel categories, not a municipality → town → village hierarchy.

schemes.name: Traditional authorities
schemes.note: Traditional authorities are recorded separately from regional and local councils.

institutions.name: National Assembly
institutions.description: Namibia's National Assembly debates and passes legislation. Referred bills are considered by the National Council through the constitutional legislative process.

institutions.name: National Council
institutions.description: Reviews bills referred by the National Assembly. It is represented separately from the Assembly and from regional councils.

institutions.name: Ministry of Urban and Rural Development
institutions.description: Works with regional councils, local authorities and traditional authorities. Its dated structure source distinguishes these schemes.

institutions.name: Namibia Statistics Agency
institutions.description: Produces and coordinates official statistics. Geographic and statistical reference periods must be retained separately.

institutions.name: Electoral Commission of Namibia
institutions.description: Administers elections. Its 2025 regional-council register identifies constituencies separately from local-authority areas.
